# Spott.ca

> Spott.ca is Canada's modern business directory and marketplace — discover, review, and connect with verified local businesses, or buy, sell, and trade in your community.

Spott helps Canadians find trustworthy local businesses (restaurants, beauty, health, home services, automotive, professional services, retail, events) and shop the marketplace for local deals. Owners can claim their listings and unlock marketplace seller tools.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search verified local Canadian businesses and explore the marketplace.
- [Browse](/browse): Filter businesses by category, city, and keyword.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Buy, sell, and trade items with people nearby.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans for business owners — Free, Pro, and Business tiers.
- [Add your business](/new-listing): Owners can create an AI-assisted listing.
- [Sign in or sign up](/auth): Customer and business owner accounts.
